title: Jitsi's window is rendered twice when it loses focus
observation: Jitsi's window is rendered twice when it loses focus ### Description: When another window is focused, Jitsi's window get duplicated. A video of the issue (the window on the left it Jitsi, the one on the middle/right is an alacritty terminal). https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/730811/129249475-c6dc547a-f260-412e-95d2-7274bf7da2c8.mp4 If I'm sharing screen or webcam, the duplicate renders this too. It also steals focus from whatever other window had focus, and the only way to focus a non-Jitsi window is to focus on that duplicate and then back to another window. I'm using the flatpak version, on sway, but it's running via XWayland (e.g.: using its xorg backend). ### Steps to reproduce: 1. Join any conference 2.
